about: I am a systems and operational architect. I translate complex workflows into maintainable systems and working software.
I focus on software that can run offline, on a local network, or fully on your machines.
My background spans operational architecture, design systems, workflow design, and implementation on the web and on the desktop.
How I work: collaborative discovery, then a first working version, then a version you can run for real, with documentation and a clear handoff.
servicesPlain: Map how the week actually runs, then ship the simplest working software that fixes the pain.
Custom websites and platforms for service businesses.
Booking, payments, and client records in one place, so you stop stitching them by hand.
Software that runs on your own machines and keeps your data local.
Packaged, locally hosted tools if you would rather buy than commission a build. Licensing can be per seat or per site.
Short milestones, clear ownership, and a handoff you can run without me sitting in the file.
engagements: Discovery and architecture: assess needs and design the target workflow.
First working version: de-risk the decision with something you can use.
Build and deploy: a version you can run, with documentation.
Support and iteration: keep improving what is already in use.
